app.title: 🏦 Bank Statement Analyzer
app.caption: Parse, categorize, and visualize bank statements from Armenian and international banks.

currency.converted: This statement is in {code}. Amounts were converted to AMD at the rates of {date}.
currency.approximate: {count} transactions are older than the first saved rates, so their AMD amounts are approximate.
currency.stale: Fresh rates could not be downloaded, so the last saved ones were used.
currency.no_rates: This statement is in {code}, but there are no exchange rates yet. Add CURRENCY_API_KEY to .env (or to Streamlit Secrets) and load the file again.
currency.no_rates_display: There is no exchange rate for {code} yet, so amounts are shown in AMD. Check CURRENCY_API_KEY and try again in a few minutes.

auth.error_email_taken: An account with this email already exists.
auth.error_password_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.error_invalid_input: Enter a valid email and a name.
auth.account_language_help: The app opens in this language after you sign in, and reminder emails use it. You can change it later in Account settings.

account.clear_help: Deletes all uploaded transactions and detected recurring payments. Your category corrections are kept.
account.delete_help: Deletes your account and everything saved for it. You will be signed out.
account.confirm: I understand this can't be undone
account.language_help: The app opens in this language after you sign in, and reminder emails use it. The switch at the top of the sidebar changes only the current session.
account.notify_help: Sent to {email}: a reminder before each recurring payment, and a warning when a category goes over its budget. Emails use your account language.

explorer.currency_note: Amounts in {code}, converted from AMD at the rates of {date}. Stored data stays in AMD.
explorer.currency_approximate: {count} transactions are older than the first saved rates, so their amounts are approximate.
explorer.no_columns: Please select at least one column to display and export.
explorer.override_success: Category updated to '{category}'. Rules/dataset updated for retraining.
explorer.converted_note: Some amounts were converted to AMD. The values from the statement are in the Original amount and Original currency columns.

budget.no_anomalies: No anomalies detected at this threshold.

recurring.none_found: No recurring payments found yet. They show up after about three months of statements.
recurring.dismiss_help: Not actually a regular payment? Hide it and it won't come back.
recurring.add_help: For regular payments that don't appear in your statements: cash, another bank, someone else's card.
recurring.add_error: Enter a name and an amount above zero.

advisor.no_data: Upload a statement to get a forecast and advice.
advisor.as_of: Based on transactions up to {date}: day {day} of {days}.
advisor.expected: Expected by the end of the month
advisor.forecast_help: Everyday spending is extended at its current daily pace. Recurring payments are counted once, on their due date. Transfers and cash withdrawals aren't counted as spending.
advisor.early: It's only day {day} of the month, so advice is based on what's already spent, without a projection.
advisor.over_budget: **{category}**: already {excess} {currency} over the {reference} {currency} budget. At this pace the month will end at about {projected} {currency}.
advisor.budget_pace: **{category}**: {spent} {currency} spent so far. At this pace it will reach about {projected} {currency}, which is {excess} {currency} over the {reference} {currency} budget.
advisor.above_usual: **{category}**: heading for about {projected} {currency} this month, {pct}% more than your usual {reference} {currency}.
advisor.all_good: Nothing to worry about this month: every category is within its budget and close to your usual spending.

alerts.intro: Payments from the last 90 days that are worth a second look. These are hints, not proof of fraud. If you don't recognise a payment, contact your bank.

kinds.new_merchant_large: Large payment to a new merchant

messages.duplicate_charge: Charged again {minutes} min after an identical payment.
messages.duplicate_same_day: A second identical charge on the same day.
messages.new_merchant_large: First payment to this merchant, and above {threshold} {currency} (95% of your payments are smaller).

welcome.info: Upload a statement file (CSV, XLSX, XLS, PDF) using the sidebar to get started.
features: Statements from Ameriabank, ACBA, Inecobank, Evocabank and other banks
Supports CSV, XLSX, XLS, and PDF formats
Interactive charts, budget tracking, and export functionality

email.subject: Bank Statement Analyzer: upcoming payments
email.footer: You get these emails because reminders are on in Bank Statement Analyzer. You can turn them off under Account settings.
